## About me

I'm an **AI Engineer and Data Scientist** who builds AI systems that ship — not just models that score well in a notebook. My work spans **LLM agents and RAG**, **deep learning for computer vision**, **end-to-end ML pipelines**, and **native iOS apps** that put AI directly into people's hands.
